desc:
🚌 Embark on an endless journey in a desert filled with events.
Find unique items, show off decorations, earn medals, and claim rewards as you go.

⭐️ Consider liking and favoriting the game to see more updates in the future

⚒️ VIP Servers are free and grant the owner a panel to manage their server

✨ Plus users benefit from the following:
2x personal MP$
1 medal every two minutes
Exclusive title

🫂 The game is much better if played with friends!

⚠️ You may try to change the following settings in case of performance issues:
Disable "Road Smoothing"
Enable "Reduced Animations"

📢 Join the amazing group https://www.roblox.com/groups/5198982/Desert-Bus-Fan-Club

Players can initiate a vote kick by chatting "/votekick " followed by the name of the person
